# cloudminator_vpc (Resource)

A virtual private cloud: an isolated address space that subnets are carved from. `name` and `tags` change in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudminator_vpc" "main" {
  name   = "main"
  region = "eu-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Not unique.
- `region` (String) Region id (see `cloudminator_regions`).

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) IPv4 range. Omit to have the platform allocate one.
- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Defaults to the provider's `project` (or `default`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Key/value tags. Used by attribute-based access control, so a change can be denied if the new tags fall outside the caller's scope.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned VPC id (`vpc-…`).
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase reported by the platform (`Running`, `Stopped`, …).

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a VPC by organization, project and VPC id.
terraform import cloudminator_vpc.main acme/default/vpc-0123456789abcdef01234567
```
